tasks.title: #33 narrow the tag catch; REASON_INTERNAL crash path with report flush
tasks.test_approach: Red first in the new tests/test_series.py: a two-patient synthetic tree where masks.build_masks itself (outside quiet_call, so the error is not turned into a refusal) is monkeypatched for the second patient to raise TypeError carrying a UID-like synthetic string; a plan whose RTPLAN lacks a required tag. CLI test: a subprocess runs 'python -c' that monkeypatches rt_dataprep.masks.build_masks to raise TypeError, sets sys.argv, then calls runpy.run_module('rt_dataprep', run_name='__main__'); the entry module is never imported by its dotted name. Then run the full suite (157 at e789e5a). The UID-like string in the TypeError message keeps digit runs short (e.g. 1.2.3.4.5), reusing the A2.10 test pattern in tests/test_convert.py.
criteria: B1 (#33): a required tag missing from a plan's header still refuses that plan with REASON_MISSING_TAG. One small helper runs a call and, after its except block exits, converts AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError or ValueError into CaseRefused(REASON_MISSING_TAG). It wraps each header-only call individually: _assemble, _check_volume, _check_contour_images, the dose candidate selection and each _check_dose_header call (split _read_dose_sum so header checks and pixel reads are separate), masks.classify, the series.csv row building, and one wrapped call that reads the bare FrameOfReferenceUID / SeriesInstanceUID values now read inline. _read_ct, _read_dose, build_masks and every write are not wrapped
REASON_INTERNAL is a fixed constant in convert.py; convert() raises a new ConvertAborted(Exception) (not a subclass of ValueError, OSError or CaseRefused) whose str is exactly REASON_INTERNAL

B1: an exception raised outside the tag catch on the second of two patients leaves the first patient's rows and a REASON_INTERNAL patient row for the second in convert_report.csv; the second patient's plan rows are dropped and it has no output or partial folder
B1: convert() then raises an error with fixed text, raised after the except block exits (a flag), whose str, __cause__ and __context__ hold no part of the original message; capfd captures none of it
B1: a log record names the exception class (TypeError) and the innermost rt_dataprep frame as module name and line number, with no file path and no message or arguments
KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit are not caught by the internal-error path: no REASON_INTERNAL row, and PR 1's flag-based partial cleanup still runs

The CLI catches ConvertAborted and exits 1 with empty stdout; stderr's last line is exactly 'rt_dataprep: ' + REASON_INTERNAL, and no stderr line holds the original exception message, a UID or a path (amended 2026-11-03, user decision: the crash-site log line stays visible in the CLI)
The full suite passes; any existing test that now raises is a PR 1 bug fixed in this task, and the catch is never widened again to make it pass

The traceback is walked via sys.exc_info()[2] and traceback.walk_tb; the module name comes from the frame's f_globals['__name__'] and the line from the walk's lineno; the frame filename only selects the innermost rt_dataprep frame and is never formatted; tests read the chain with getattr(err, '__cause__') and getattr(err, '__context__')

Guardrail (commit gate): no added line puts mrn/patient_id next to a run of 6-10 digits and no added line has a dotted name whose last part starts with an underscore; at most 5 staged files per commit
At patient level the except for unexpected exceptions comes after except OSError, so an output-side OSError still gives REASON_IO_ERROR, not REASON_INTERNAL

tasks.title: series.py: generic volume check and geometry-owning series read
tasks.test_approach: Unit tests on series.py with fixture series written to tmp_path (red first): sagittal MR, two-echo MR, multi-frame file, missing middle slice, no PixelSpacing, off-orthonormal oblique MR, 0.005 mm jitter, PT with per-slice slopes.
criteria: The volume check allows any orientation and requires: single-frame files (NumberOfFrames absent or 1); one ImageOrientationPatient within DIRECTION_ATOL with unit-length, orthogonal row and column cosines within ORTHO_ATOL (row and column are normalized before the direction is built); one image size, one PixelSpacing within SERIES_ATOL_MM, one FrameOfReferenceUID; at least two slices; files sorted ascending by position . (row x column cosine); step = (last - first)/(n - 1) along the normal with step > SERIES_ATOL_MM; every position within SERIES_ATOL_MM (= 0.01 mm) of first + k*step, sideways included
A missing or malformed tag in the volume check makes the series skipped (a skip result, not an exception); no exception escapes the check for a bad header

B2: a sagittal MR is read with direction (row cosine, column cosine, normal as columns), origin = first position and spacing (PixelSpacing, step) all set from the validated headers and equal to them; a two-echo MR, a multi-frame file, a series with a missing middle slice, a series lacking PixelSpacing and an oblique MR whose cosines are off-orthonormal by 1e-3 are each skipped; a series whose positions jitter by 0.005 mm is read

Only Execute runs inside quiet_call (float32 output pixel type set before Execute); the size check (columns, rows, n) and the geometry setting run outside it; a size mismatch or a read failure skips the series
B5: a PT series with a different RescaleSlope on every slice reads as stored x RescaleSlope + RescaleIntercept in float32, checked voxelwise
B8 (read part): reading a series with truncated pixel data skips it with nothing captured by capfd, log records or warnings that holds the synthetic id, the tmp path or a UID

Vault guardrails followed: pixel arrays are copied with GetArrayFromImage, never a view of a temporary (simpleitk-array-view-of-temporary-image-reads-freed-memory); every third-party read is inside quiet_call (third-party-loader-errors-and-warnings-embed-phi-paths)
The planning CT path in convert.py is unchanged

Guardrail (commit gate): no added line puts mrn/patient_id next to a run of 6-10 digits and no added line has a dotted name whose last part starts with an underscore; at most 5 staged files per commit
series.py imports nothing from convert.py: it defines SERIES_ATOL_MM = 0.01, ORTHO_ATOL = 1e-4 and its own DIRECTION_ATOL = 1e-6; convert.py is not edited in this task
If TDD shows SimpleITK does not apply each slice's own RescaleSlope, the PT read falls back to per-slice pydicom pixel reads inside quiet_call; B5 is never weakened
A series whose cosines are off unit length or orthogonality by 1e-6 (DS rounding) is read; one off by 1e-3 is skipped

tasks.title: series.py: REG parsing and reg_matrix
tasks.test_approach: Unit tests on the registration lookup with REG fixtures (red first): MR frame +10 mm in x of the CT frame, REG in the CT frame and REG in the MR frame, a named MR-frame point mapped to its known CT-frame coordinates; bad matrices; duplicate items; items resolved via ReferencedImageSequence.
criteria: A2.4 (matrix part): for a REG in the CT frame and for one in the MR frame, reg_matrix maps a named MR-frame point to its known CT-frame coordinates within 1e-6; the same frame gives 'identity'; the text is 16 values row-major, space-separated, %.10g
A series on the planning CT's frame gets 'identity' whatever any REG holds; REG lookup runs only for a series on another frame
Registration is symmetric: a REG whose own FrameOfReferenceUID is the CT's (or the series') frame has an implied identity item for that frame when it omits one

A REG qualifies for a (CT frame, series frame) pair when it has an item (real or implied) for each frame, whatever its matrices hold; the first qualifying REG by SOPInstanceUID (string order) is used, with no fallback to a later REG; only REGs not in an excluded study are used

B3: an item matrix is used only when its MatrixSequence holds exactly one entry of type RIGID with 16 values, last row 0 0 0 1 within 1e-6, and a 3x3 part R with max|R^T R - I| <= 1e-4 and det R > 0; a non-RIGID type, a matrix scaled by 1.1, an item with two matrices, or a REG with two items for the CT frame gives an empty reg_matrix while the series still counts as registered

B9: an item without FrameOfReferenceUID takes the one frame shared by those of its ReferencedImageSequence SOPs present among the patient's readable headers (excluded studies and localizers included, absent SOPs ignored); listing only SOPs not in the patient's files, or SOPs on two frames, gives the item no frame
A study-level link with no frame match does not register a series; deformable REGs (no RegistrationSequence) never qualify
A malformed REG tag makes that REG not qualify; no exception escapes REG parsing for a bad header

Guardrail (commit gate): no added line puts mrn/patient_id next to a run of 6-10 digits and no added line has a dotted name whose last part starts with an underscore; at most 5 staged files per commit

tasks.title: Other-series placement, images/, plan-less patients, report rows
tasks.test_approach: End-to-end convert() tests on synthetic organized trees in tests/test_series.py (red first), one per criterion; assertions read the NIfTI files back and parse series.csv and convert_report.csv.
criteria: convert.py imports DIRECTION_ATOL from series.py (one definition, value 1e-6 unchanged) and uses series.py's helpers; series.py never imports convert.py

Candidates: Modality CT, MR or PT; SOP copies deduplicated to the first path in folder order (plan_<n> by numeric n, then misc_files/) before grouping by SeriesInstanceUID; not the planning CT of a converted plan; study not excluded (a study is excluded when any of the patient's files in it has a ManufacturerModelName containing an excluded model, case-sensitive substring; a file with no StudyInstanceUID is excluded); files whose ImageType list contains LOCALIZER dropped one by one; files with no SeriesInstanceUID or Modality dropped and not counted; placement runs after every plan of the patient has its outcome

A2.4: an MR registered to the planning CT's frame by a REG leaves planning_ct.nii.gz, dose and masks unchanged and is written into the plan folder as series_MR_1.nii.gz on its own grid; its series.csv row carries kind series, its SeriesDescription, UIDs, frame, date, the plan columns and the reg_matrix; an MR whose study a REG names but whose frame it does not goes to images/
A2.4b: two CT series in one study on different frames with no REG: the one the RTSTRUCT references is planning_ct.nii.gz, and the other is <patient>/images/series_CT_1.nii.gz

A2.4c: an MR registered to two plans' CTs is written into both plan folders; an MR in misc_files/ with no registration is written once to images/; a refused plan's CT, on a frame different from every converted plan's CT frame (the fixture ensures it), goes to images/; a patient with only misc_files/ gets images/; an org tree holding .<patient>.partial/ does not convert it

k counts from 1 per folder and modality, assigned only among series actually written to that folder (no gaps; a skipped series takes no k), in order of (SeriesDate, SeriesTime, SeriesInstanceUID) of each series' first sorted slice, '' when absent; series in images/ have plan columns and reg_matrix empty
B4: an MR in a study that holds an excluded-model file, and an MR localizer, are not written anywhere and are not counted as skipped
B6: a series present in two plan folders and misc_files/ is read once and written once per destination, not once per copy

B7: a plan row lists its series files before series.csv; a patient with at least one candidate gets one images row (converted with its files ending series.csv when images/ was written, else skipped with REASON_NO_IMAGES); skipped_series on that row counts every skipped series of the patient once; plan rows keep 0; a patient with no candidates gets no images row; a patient with neither plans nor candidates keeps the PR 1 REASON_NO_PLANS row and gets no output folder; a plan-less patient whose candidates all fail gets an empty output folder, so a rerun skips it

B8: an unreadable series in misc_files/ is skipped with nothing captured by capfd, log records or warnings that holds the synthetic id, the tmp path or a UID; no log line or exception in series placement carries a UID, path, date or description
The closing convert log line counts images rows separately from plan rows, e.g. 'convert: %d plan rows (%d converted, %d refused, %d skipped), %d images rows' plus the patient-level counts
A2.11 still holds: the organized tree is byte-identical after a run and a rerun reports every patient as skipped

Row and file order: a patient's report rows are its plan rows in numeric plan_<n> order, then its images row; in a row's files and in each series.csv, series files come after the plan's data files, ordered by modality (CT, MR, PT) then k, and series.csv comes last in the row's files
A sagittal MR on the planning CT's frame lands in the plan folder with reg_matrix 'identity'; the NIfTI read back has direction, origin and spacing equal to the headers
A TypeError raised from series placement (monkeypatched) gives a REASON_INTERNAL patient row and ConvertAborted, as in task-01

Guardrail (commit gate): no added line puts mrn/patient_id next to a run of 6-10 digits and no added line has a dotted name whose last part starts with an underscore; at most 5 staged files per commit
A placement-path unexpected-exception except comes after except OSError at patient level (REASON_IO_ERROR rows keep their reason)
